description: Liz's shooting exposes Max's secret and binds the human and alien teenagers together. Their attempts to understand a mysterious key, a reservation, Nasedo and the 1947 crash gradually reveal that Max, Isabel and Michael are part of a much larger story than three children found in the desert.

s01e01.description: Liz Parker is shot at the Crashdown and Max Evans secretly heals her, revealing that he, Isabel and Michael are alien-human hybrids hiding in plain sight.

s01e02.description: Liz suspects a new substitute teacher may be hunting aliens, while Michael steals a key from Sheriff Valenti that could lead to answers about their origins.

s01e03.description: Fearful that Maria will expose them, Max, Isabel and Michael test her trustworthiness, with Isabel entering Maria's dreams to learn what she really feels.

s01e04.description: Liz stays beside her gravely ill grandmother while Kyle's friends attack Max, forcing Liz to confront the danger their secret relationship brings.

s01e05.description: Liz's journal disappears with the truth about Max's powers inside it, sending the group through a tense search for whoever may have learned their secret.

s01e06.description: A stolen key and Michael's obsessive search for answers send the group down Highway 285 toward a strange geodesic dome tied to the aliens' past.

s01e07.description: Max and Liz visit a reservation where River Dog may know the truth about another alien, while Michael and Maria find their mutual irritation becoming attraction.

s01e08.description: After Max is hospitalized following an accident, the group must replace his blood sample before ordinary medical tests expose what he is.

s01e09.description: An unnatural winter heat wave intensifies romances across Roswell while Liz finally tells Alex the truth about Max, Isabel and Michael.

s01e10.description: A ritual on the reservation leaves Michael dangerously ill, forcing the human and alien friends to combine what they know to save him.

s01e11.description: Max uses his powers to save his adoptive mother from a fire, reopening the question of whether he and Isabel can keep their origins hidden from their own family.

s01e12.description: A possible extraterrestrial landing draws the aliens and Sheriff Valenti into the woods, where Michael suspects River Dog knows more than he admits.

s01e13.description: Roswell's annual UFO convention becomes genuinely dangerous when men who know too much about Max arrive with very different intentions.

s01e14.description: Liz wins a radio-station blind date while Max and Kyle stumble through an unlikely drunken alliance and Michael and Isabel try to contact Nasedo.

s01e15.description: Michael finally confronts the abuse in his foster home, but when his guardian disappears the attempt to escape that life makes Michael a suspect.

s01e16.description: Max and Liz discover that physical intimacy triggers flashes of alien memories, giving the group an unexpected new route toward clues about their origins.

s01e17.description: Topolsky returns with a warning about the people hunting the aliens, while a mysterious new student, Tess, quickly inserts herself into Isabel's life.

s01e18.description: The group investigates Tess as Max feels an inexplicable pull toward her, and their surveillance uncovers a truth stranger than simple suspicion.

s01e19.description: Everyone wonders whether Tess is Nasedo while Michael and Isabel share disturbing dreams that suggest their relationships may have been planned long before Earth.

s01e20.description: Nasedo impersonates Max and kidnaps Liz to lure government agents into the open, forcing the real Max and his friends into a dangerous rescue.

s01e21.description: Max is captured and tortured by the FBI's secret alien unit, leaving Michael, Isabel, Tess and Nasedo to locate and free him.

s01e22.description: On the run from the FBI, the four alien teens learn the purpose for which they were sent to Earth and face a destiny that threatens their human relationships.
